note: A REFERENCE, NOT A LAYER, and the distinction matters. Wikidata knows which polities existed and when they ended. It does not know WHICH ARCHIVE HOLDS THEIR RECORDS, which is the only thing the jurisdiction layer is for — that is the column this project writes by hand and the reason the layer is fourteen regions rather than three thousand. This file is here so that whoever authors the fifteenth has the dates to hand and can cite them, not so that a machine can author it.
